learning_modalities.attention_span: Burst-oriented: High intensity followed by need for physical release
learning_modalities.ideal_environment: Montessori, active sports programs, competitive games, hands-on science experiments
learning_modalities.parent_coaching_tip: Do not expect them to sit still for 45 minutes of homework. Break study sessions into 15-minute high-energy sprints with jumping jacks in between.

learning_modalities.attention_span: Sustained & Focused: Excels at methodical, repetitive mastery
learning_modalities.ideal_environment: Structured classical schooling, nature-based Waldorf schools, calm sensory classrooms
learning_modalities.parent_coaching_tip: Give them clear step-by-step checklists. Rushing them causes deep anxiety and stubborn refusal.

learning_modalities.attention_span: Rapid & Multi-track: Synthesizes multiple ideas simultaneously, easily bored by rote memorization
learning_modalities.ideal_environment: Inquiry-based learning, bilingual immersion, creative technology labs
learning_modalities.parent_coaching_tip: They need to talk to understand. Allow them to explain their thoughts out loud rather than forcing silent studying.

learning_modalities.attention_span: Atmospheric: Focus depends directly on their emotional comfort with the teacher and peers
learning_modalities.ideal_environment: Waldorf, gentle arts-integrated schooling, small nurturing classroom pods
learning_modalities.parent_coaching_tip: If they have a clash with a harsh teacher, their grades will drop across all subjects. Focus on emotional safety before academic performance.
